display.purpose: The empty-stage prompt glyphs only — the product's own monospace at hero scale.

headline.purpose: The login h1; the one large sans moment.

body.purpose: Controls, rows, copy at fleet density; meta lines drop to 11px in Dimmed Readout.

label.purpose: Eyebrows and HUD buttons: uppercase, 600, ~0.09em tracking.

mono.purpose: Terminal cells, logs, commands, fingerprints, session names — never chrome.

shadows.name: floating-chrome
shadows.purpose: The login card — the only large ambient shadow; shadow means altitude.

shadows.name: identity-glow
shadows.purpose: Brand logo and nameplate aura — glow means identity.

shadows.name: hover-bloom
shadows.purpose: HUD buttons on hover — glow means attention.

shadows.name: engaged-aura
shadows.purpose: Fleet Command while active (pulses 2.4s) — the glow ceiling; nothing shines brighter.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus via :focus-visible; an outline, not a shadow, so it never shifts layout.

shadows.name: inset-beacon
shadows.purpose: Selection: the 3px cyan bar on a selected row's left edge, paired with a 0.12-alpha cyan wash.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover/engage state changes on buttons and rows.

motion.name: slide-chrome
motion.purpose: Drawers and panels sliding in from the right; the sidebar rail collapse (0.25s on grid columns).

motion.name: sheen-sweep
motion.purpose: Fleet Command's diagonal sheen crossing on hover.

motion.name: engaged-pulse
motion.purpose: The active Fleet Command aura breathing.

motion.name: cursor-blink
motion.purpose: The empty-stage block cursor; holds solid under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: modal-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Modal field/tools grids collapse to one column.

breakpoints.name: hub-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Proxmox hub goes 92vw; master-detail and container rows stack.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a screen exists for — Unlock, Run on N boxes. Phosphor cyan→green gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(36,211,232,0.38); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(36,211,232,0.22), rgba(88,229,140,0.16)); color: var(--text, #d8e1ea); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: rgba(36,211,232,0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(36,211,232,0.65); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: HUD Button
components.description: The fleet console voice: uppercase tracked label on raised glass, lighting cyan on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-hud { padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(36,211,232,0.3); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(36,211,232,0.07), rgba(36,211,232,0) 65%), var(--panel-2, #111824); color: #c2eaf1; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.2px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-hud:hover { border-color: rgba(36,211,232,0.6); color: var(--cyan, #24d3e8); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(36,211,232,0.12), inset 0 0 8px rgba(36,211,232,0.05); } .ds-btn-hud:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(36,211,232,0.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action — Inspect, Cancel. Hairline at rest, warms on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #202938); background: var(--panel-2, #111824); color: var(--text, #d8e1ea); font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(36,211,232,0.45); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(36,211,232,0.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Raised-glass field that glows awake on focus instead of jumping.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #202938); background: var(--panel-2, #111824); color: var(--text, #d8e1ea); font-size: 13px; outline: none; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #7f8b9a); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(36,211,232,0.45); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(36,211,232,0.12); }

components.name: Session Chip
components.description: Pill picker for tmux session names; selection speaks cyan.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #202938); background: var(--panel-2, #111824); color: var(--text, #d8e1ea); cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(36,211,232,0.45); } .ds-chip-selected { border-color: var(--cyan, #24d3e8); color: var(--cyan, #24d3e8); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(36,211,232,0.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic status pills — info in cyan, warnings in amber; never decorative.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.5; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-info { color: var(--cyan, #24d3e8); border-color: rgba(36,211,232,0.4); background: rgba(36,211,232,0.1); } .ds-badge-warn { color: #d29922; border-color: rgba(210,153,34,0.4); background: rgba(210,153,34,0.12); }

components.name: Box Row
components.description: The signature instrument: status dot, name, dimmed meta readout, and the Inset Beacon when attached.
components.html:
• cpu 12% · mem 38% · disk 41%
  • needs login
components.css: .ds-boxes { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 260px; background: #090d13; } .ds-box { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-box:hover { background: var(--panel-2, #111824); } .ds-box-active { background: rgba(36,211,232,0.12); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--cyan, #24d3e8); } .ds-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--muted, #7f8b9a); flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-dot-green { background: #2ea043; } .ds-dot-auth { background: #a371f7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(163,113,247,0.25); } .ds-box-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; } .ds-box-name { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text, #d8e1ea); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; } .ds-box-name:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(36,211,232,0.65); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-box-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted, #7f8b9a); }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-center transient notice; rises 16px while fading in, role=status.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-block; background: var(--panel-2, #111824); color: var(--text, #d8e1ea); border: 1px solid var(--border, #202938); padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); }

narrative.overview: Tmuxifier looks like the bridge of a ship on night watch: a near-black blue field, a handful of phosphor-lit instruments, and one operator with calm authority over many vessels. Everything on screen is an instrument — box rows are berth listings, the fleet buttons are a command console, the terminal is the main viewport — and instruments are quiet at rest, lit when touched, unmistakable when active. The personality is calm, precise, quietly lit: glow is rationed, severity colors carry meaning, and density serves scanning a fleet at a glance. Two confirmed anti-references bound the world on both sides: not neon cyberpunk overload, and not a generic SaaS dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: One accent hue (Phosphor Cyan) doing all identity, focus, and selection work
Near-black blue depths layered tonally: hull, rail, panel, raised panel, terminal well
Tracked-out uppercase micro-labels as the HUD voice; terminal monospace as the display voice
Severity colors (red/amber/green/purple) reserved strictly for status semantics
Flat surfaces with 1px hairlines; glow signals state, shadow signals altitude
Dense, scannable rows built for dozens of boxes, not marketing whitespace

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Phosphor Cyan is the only accent. No foreign blues — the GitHub-blue literals (#1f6feb, #2f6feb) still present on some modal submits and tab underlines are legacy drift scheduled for retirement, never a precedent.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Red, amber, green, and purple appear only as status semantics tied to a real machine state. Never decorate with them.

rules.name: The Wash Ladder Rule
rules.body: Interactive cyan comes as alpha washes on the documented ladder (0.05 / 0.12 / 0.22 / 0.45 / 0.65); don't invent intermediate opacities per surface.

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only where content is machine text — commands, logs, paths, fingerprints, prompt glyphs. UI chrome never wears it for style.

rules.name: The Tracked Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + tracking is the HUD register, reserved for micro-labels (≤13px). Never track body copy or headlines beyond 1px.

rules.name: The Glow Is State Rule
rules.body: Cyan light means identity, attention, or engagement — never altitude. Black shadow means altitude — never decoration. A surface at rest is flat with a hairline.

rules.name: The Inset Beacon Rule
rules.body: Selection is a 3px cyan bar inset on the left edge of the selected row (inset 3px 0 0) plus a 0.12-alpha cyan wash — boxes, groups, the Host Shell all signal "attached here" the same way. Never a filled row, never an outline.

dos: Do pull every color from the frontmatter tokens; the :root custom properties (--bg, --panel, --panel-2, --border, --text, --muted, --cyan, --green) are the same system in code.
Do use the cyan wash ladder (0.05 / 0.12 / 0.22 / 0.45 / 0.65) for interactive states, and the Inset Beacon (3px inset bar + 0.12 wash) for selection.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion alternative that holds the element in a meaningful resting state (the cursor stays solid, the pulse stays lit) — never delete the element.
Do keep machine text in the bundled Meslo mono and put logs/terminals in the Terminal Well, one tonal step below the chrome around them.
Do write micro-labels in the HUD register: 10.5–12px, 600, uppercase, ~0.09em tracking.
donts: Don't introduce foreign accent hues. The GitHub blues (#1f6feb, #2f6feb) on modal submits and tab underlines are known drift being retired — match new work to Phosphor Cyan, and prefer replacing a blue you touch.

Don't reach for the legacy near-duplicate grays (#c9d1d9, #8b949e, #6e7681, #232a36, #131722, #0f131c, #3fb950) — use Instrument White, Dimmed Readout, Hairline, Glass Panel, and OK Green. The duplicates fragment contrast (some fail AA where the token passes).
Don't use severity colors decoratively, and never repurpose Needs-Auth Purple.
Don't exceed the Engaged Aura glow ceiling or add large ambient shadows to resting surfaces — no SaaS card-grid look, no neon flood.
Don't let chrome outdress the terminal: no display-size sans headlines inside the app, no ornament on the stage beyond the empty-state prompt.
